tooltips.title: Arrange
tooltips.body: Toggle the dashboard layout lock. While unlocked, long-press any card and drag it to reposition; lock when the arrangement suits you. Your layout persists per screen.

tooltips.title: Edit mode
tooltips.body: Long-press a card and drag to arrange — lock when done.

tooltips.title: Overlord cycle
tooltips.body: One autonomous recon-act-report cycle at the configured interval. Camera-first: the CAMWAR sweep always runs before the decision loop.

tooltips.title: Kill switch
tooltips.body: Queues a wipe task on every known implant and halts autonomous actions. Queued wipes cannot be recalled — this is the app's only irreversible control.

tooltips.title: Scan net
tooltips.body: Runs the network recon module against the current scope (local /24 by default, or the CIDR set in Settings).

tooltips.title: AI mode
tooltips.body: online: remote API. local: on-device model. deterministic: QBrain plans everything offline — no network, fully reproducible.

tooltips.title: Job card
tooltips.body: Every long-running operation renders as a job card: phase, progress, a live log tail, and Stop when cancelable. Same shape everywhere.
